explanation: erdosproblems.com/626: Erdős proved lim log h^{(m)}(n)/log n ≫ 1/m. Since existence of the limit is open, the Lean statement uses the lower-limit form: ∃ absolute c > 0 such that ∀ m ≥ 1, ∀ ε > 0, eventually h^{(m)}(n) ≥ n^{c/m − ε}. This is the correct reading of the ≫ bound with a uniform constant. Faithful.
